notes.title: Removing CameraBag Photo from sale
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Now that CameraBag Pro is out, and we've given everyone who owns Photo on Steam a free upgrade, we'll be removing CameraBag Photo from sale. This will have no effect on you if you already own CameraBag Photo: it'll still be in your library, and we'll continue to push updates as they become available. 

CameraBag Pro should automatically be in your library if you have Photo. You can check out its Steam page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061690/CameraBag_Pro/

Please let us know if you have any questions, either here or via support@nevercenter.com.

Cheers!

notes.title: Coming soon: your free upgrade to CameraBag Pro
notes.content:
Hi folks, 

CameraBag Pro will be releasing soon on Steam, and we'll be giving everyone who owns CameraBag Photo a free upgrade as a way of saying thanks. CameraBag Pro includes everything in CameraBag Photo, and adds support for editing videos using the same toolset. You can see CameraBag Pro's Steam page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1061690/CameraBag_Pro/

NOTE: This process may take us a day or two after CameraBag Pro is released, so please be patient if it doesn't show up right away. Once finished, CameraBag Pro will magically appear in your library if you own Photo. Cheers!

notes.title: DLL update
notes.content:
We've pushed a small dll update which will correct startup issues for some CameraBag users. Please let us know if you're still having any issues. 

Cheers!

notes.title: CameraBag Photo Update 3.1.0 Now Available
notes.content:
Hi folks,

CameraBag Photo version 3.1.0 is now available here on Steam, and should update automatically for you. 

This is a minor update which includes:

 - Zoom: removed restrictions to greatly expand zoom range. You can now zoom in far beyond a 1:1 pixel view to insepct pixels, plus zoom far out to get a different perspective on your image.

- Lightleak: the oft-requested Lightleak adjustment from CameraBag 2 has been updated and is now available in CameraBag 3.x.

- Miscellaneous bug fixes.

You can read all release notes here: http://nevercenter.com/camerabag/photo/whats_new/

Cheers!

notes.title: CameraBag Photo Update 3.0.2
notes.content:
This update enables support for hi-dpi displays, and switches to 64-bit support on Windows for improved performance. 

If for any reason you cannot use the 64-bit version (rare) or otherwise want to revert, the previous build is available as a beta branch called "version_3_0_1_archive". Here's a post on how to switch to a beta branch: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=380122528 
(Right click on the app in your library, choose Properties, navigate to Betas, and select from the drop-down. No password needed.)

Cheers!

notes.title: CameraBag Photo 3.0.1 update is now available.
notes.content:
New in this update:
- fixed bug in windows that stopped images loading with certain international characters in the file path
- added new filter set: B+W Films
- Re-enabled opening next/previous image files by pressing left or right arrow keys (without holding shift)
- fixed bug where images on Mac wouldn’t load when dragged onto the app icon or opened from within another app when CameraBag wasn’t already open

Many thanks to our users who helped us track down these bugs, particularly the file path issue!
